content.short: Shrapnel is a high-fidelity AAA extraction shooter featuring true digital ownership and a creator-led modding suite.
content.description: Shrapnel is a premier AAA extraction-based first-person shooter built on Unreal Engine 5, designed to bring professional-grade gaming to the Web3 ecosystem. Originally developed on an Avalanche L1 subnet, the game provides players with true digital ownership of their in-game assets, including weapons and equipment. Shrapnel features a high-stakes competitive environment where player effort is recognized through real-world value. Following its migration to GalaChain, Shrapnel continues to bridge the gap between high-fidelity gaming and decentralized blockchain technology.
content.meta: Shrapnel is a AAA extraction shooter featuring NFT ownership and a creator economy. Discover Shrapnel and more games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
